title: Vignette for geneSetSimplifyR
text: Gene-set enrichment analysis (GSEA) one useful types bioinformatic analysis since summarizes long lists genes (e.g. TP53, CD1) high-level biological concepts (e.g. “cell cycle”, “DNA repair”). GSEA potentially extremely powerful profiling high-level biological changes system, often hampered long lists significant gene sets. point demonstrated recent article re-analyze 100 RNA-seq data sets show average dataset 1700+ gene sets significantly enriched among differentially expressed genes. naturally possible manually analyze long lists, practice scientists often just show significant/enriched gene-sets cherry-pick gene-sets based prior biological hypothesis. Neither naturally desirable (good scientific practice?), hence approaches analyzing long lists gene sets needed. created geneSetSimplifyR. geneSetSimplifyR solves problem : Grouping gene-sets small number highly redundant/overlapping clusters unsupervised clustering Intelligently assigning labels cluster making easy figure core biology behind cluster Providing host intuitive plots enabling visualization exploration clusters geneSetSimplifyR works output gene-set enrichment analysis tool works especially well fgsea.

text: variance Standard deviations LSI components, stored Seurat object seuratObj@reductions$lsi@stdev. Must sorted decreasing order. method elbow-detection method use.
